content: Kwa hiyo Mungu akaumba viumbe wakubwa wa baharini na kila kiumbe hai kiendacho majini kulingana na aina zake, na kila ndege mwenye mabawa kulingana na aina yake. Mungu akaona kuwa hili ni jema.

teaching.description: UUMBAJI WA MBINGU NA NCHI, ARDHI, NURU, JUA NA MWEZI, NCHI KAVU, MIMEA, WANYAMA, KUBARIKIWA KWA WANYAMA NA KUUMBWA KWA MWANADAMU

content: Nao wanyama wote wa dunia, ndege wote wa angani, na viumbe vyote viendavyo juu ya ardhi: yaani kila kiumbe chenye pumzi ya uhai, ninawapa kila mche wa kijani kuwa chakula.” Ikawa hivyo.

teaching.description: SABATO, KUUMBWA KWA MWANADAMU, NA MASHARTI WALIOPEWA ADAMU NA HAWA

teaching.description: WANA WA YAFETHI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 10:1-11:3

content: Wakasemezana wao kwa wao, “Njooni, tufyatue matofali na tuyachome vizuri kwa moto.” Walitumia matofali badala ya mawe, na lami kwa ajili ya kushikamanishia hayo matofali.

teaching.description: WANA WA YAFETHI

teaching.description: KUJENGWA KWA MNARA WA BABELI

teaching.name: Mwanzo 11:4-32

content: Tera alipokuwa bado hai, Harani akafa huko Uru ya Wakaldayo, nchi alimozaliwa.

content: Kwa upande wa Ishmaeli, nimekusikia: hakika nitambariki, nitamfanya awe na uzao mwingi na nitaongeza sana idadi yake. Atakuwa baba wa watawala kumi na wawili, nami nitamfanya awe taifa kubwa.

teaching.description: AGANO KUHUSU UZAO NA NCHI; TOHARA, ISHARA YA AGANO; MUNGU ABADILISHA JINA LA SARAI KUWA SARA NA KUMWAHIDI MWANA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 17:8-18:8

content: Lakini Agano langu nitalithibitisha kwa Isaki, ambaye Sara atakuzalia mwaka ujao majira kama haya.”

teaching.description: AGANO KUHUSU UZAO NA NCHI; TOHARA, ISHARA YA AGANO; MUNGU ABADILISHA JINA LA SARAI KUWA SARA NA KUMWAHIDI MWANA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 17:8-18:8

content: Wakati alipomaliza kuzungumza na Abrahamu, Mungu akapanda juu akaondoka kwa Abrahamu.

teaching.description: AGANO KUHUSU UZAO NA NCHI; TOHARA, ISHARA YA AGANO; MUNGU ABADILISHA JINA LA SARAI KUWA SARA NA KUMWAHIDI MWANA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 17:8-18:8

content: Siku ile ile, Abrahamu akamchukua Ishmaeli mwanawe na wote waliozaliwa nyumbani mwake pamoja na walionunuliwa kwa fedha zake, kila mwanaume wa nyumbani mwake, akawatahiri, kama Mungu alivyomwagiza.

teaching.description: AGANO KUHUSU UZAO NA NCHI; TOHARA, ISHARA YA AGANO; MUNGU ABADILISHA JINA LA SARAI KUWA SARA NA KUMWAHIDI MWANA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 17:8-18:8

content: Abrahamu alikuwa na umri wa miaka tisini na tisa alipotahiriwa,

teaching.description: AGANO KUHUSU UZAO NA NCHI; TOHARA, ISHARA YA AGANO; MUNGU ABADILISHA JINA LA SARAI KUWA SARA NA KUMWAHIDI MWANA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 17:8-18:8

content: naye Ishmaeli mwanawe alitahiriwa akiwa na umri wa miaka kumi na mitatu.

teaching.description: AGANO KUHUSU UZAO NA NCHI; TOHARA, ISHARA YA AGANO; MUNGU ABADILISHA JINA LA SARAI KUWA SARA NA KUMWAHIDI MWANA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 17:8-18:8

content: Abrahamu na Ishmaeli mwanawe walitahiriwa siku ile ile,

teaching.description: AGANO KUHUSU UZAO NA NCHI; TOHARA, ISHARA YA AGANO; MUNGU ABADILISHA JINA LA SARAI KUWA SARA NA KUMWAHIDI MWANA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 17:8-18:8

content: Kila mwanaume nyumbani mwa Abrahamu, pamoja na wote waliozaliwa nyumbani mwake au aliyenunuliwa kwa fedha kutoka kwa mgeni, alitahiriwa pamoja naye.

teaching.description: AGANO KUHUSU UZAO NA NCHI; TOHARA, ISHARA YA AGANO; MUNGU ABADILISHA JINA LA SARAI KUWA SARA NA KUMWAHIDI MWANA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 17:8-18:8

content: Bwana akamtokea Abrahamu karibu na mialoni ya Mamre wakati alipokuwa ameketi kwenye ingilio la hema lake wakati wa adhuhuri.

teaching.description: AGANO KUHUSU UZAO NA NCHI; TOHARA, ISHARA YA AGANO; MUNGU ABADILISHA JINA LA SARAI KUWA SARA NA KUMWAHIDI MWANA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 17:8-18:8

content: Abrahamu akainua macho akaona watu watatu wamesimama karibu naye. Alipowaona, aliharakisha kutoka kwenye ingilio la hema lake kuwalaki na kuwasujudia hadi nchi.

teaching.description: AGANO KUHUSU UZAO NA NCHI; TOHARA, ISHARA YA AGANO; MUNGU ABADILISHA JINA LA SARAI KUWA SARA NA KUMWAHIDI MWANA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 17:8-18:8

content: Akasema, “Kama nimepata kibali machoni penu, ee bwana wangu, usimpite mtumishi wako.

teaching.description: AGANO KUHUSU UZAO NA NCHI; TOHARA, ISHARA YA AGANO; MUNGU ABADILISHA JINA LA SARAI KUWA SARA NA KUMWAHIDI MWANA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 17:8-18:8

content: Acha yaletwe maji kidogo, kisha ninyi nyote mnawe miguu yenu na mpumzike chini ya mti huu.

teaching.description: AGANO KUHUSU UZAO NA NCHI; TOHARA, ISHARA YA AGANO; MUNGU ABADILISHA JINA LA SARAI KUWA SARA NA KUMWAHIDI MWANA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 17:8-18:8

content:
Niruhusuni niwapatie chakula kidogo mle, ili mpate nguvu mwendelee na safari yenu, kwa kuwa mmekuja kwa mtumishi wenu.”
    Nao wakamjibu, “Vema sana, fanya kama unavyosema.”

teaching.description: AGANO KUHUSU UZAO NA NCHI; TOHARA, ISHARA YA AGANO; MUNGU ABADILISHA JINA LA SARAI KUWA SARA NA KUMWAHIDI MWANA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 17:8-18:8

content: Hivyo Abrahamu akaharakisha akaingia hemani kwa Sara, akamwambia, “Chukua vipimo vitatu vya unga laini haraka, ukande na uoke mikate.”

teaching.description: AGANO KUHUSU UZAO NA NCHI; TOHARA, ISHARA YA AGANO; MUNGU ABADILISHA JINA LA SARAI KUWA SARA NA KUMWAHIDI MWANA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 17:8-18:8

content: Kisha Abrahamu akakimbia kwenda kwenye kundi, akachagua ndama mzuri, laini na akampa mtumishi, ambaye aliharakisha kumtayarisha.

teaching.description: AGANO KUHUSU UZAO NA NCHI; TOHARA, ISHARA YA AGANO; MUNGU ABADILISHA JINA LA SARAI KUWA SARA NA KUMWAHIDI MWANA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 17:8-18:8

content: Kisha akaleta jibini, maziwa na nyama ya yule ndama iliyoandaliwa, akaviweka mbele ya wageni. Walipokuwa wakila, alisimama karibu nao chini ya mti.

teaching.description: AGANO KUHUSU UZAO NA NCHI; TOHARA, ISHARA YA AGANO; MUNGU ABADILISHA JINA LA SARAI KUWA SARA NA KUMWAHIDI MWANA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 17:8-18:8

content:
Wakamuuliza, “Yuko wapi Sara mkeo?”
    Akasema, “Yuko huko, ndani ya hema.”

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content:
Kisha Bwana akasema, “Hakika nitakurudia tena majira kama haya mwakani na Sara mkeo atakuwa ana mwana.”
    Sara alikuwa akiwasikiliza kwenye ingilio la hema, lililokuwa nyuma yake.

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Abrahamu na Sara walikuwa wazee tena waliosogea miaka, naye Sara alikuwa amekoma katika desturi ya wanawake.

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Hivyo Sara akacheka kimoyomoyo alipokuwa akiwaza, “Baada ya mimi kuwa mkongwe hivi na bwana wangu amezeeka, je, nitaweza kufurahia jambo hili?”

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Abrahamu, “Kwa nini Sara amecheka na kusema, ‘Kweli nitazaa mtoto nami sasa ni mzee?’

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Je, kuna jambo lolote gumu lisilowezekana kwa Bwana? Nitakurudia mwakani majira kama haya, naye Sara atakuwa na mwana.”

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content:
Sara akaogopa kwa kuwa alidanganya na kusema, “Mimi sikucheka.”
    Lakini Bwana akasema, “Ndiyo, ulicheka!”

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Wakati watu hao waliposimama ili waondoke, walielekeza nyuso zao Sodoma, Abrahamu akawatoa kitambo kidogo ili awasindikize.

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Ndipo Bwana akasema, “Je, nimfiche Abrahamu jambo ninalokusudia kufanya?

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Hakika Abrahamu atakuwa taifa kubwa na lenye nguvu, kupitia kwake mataifa yote ya dunia yatabarikiwa.

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Kwa maana nimemchagua yeye, ili awaongoze watoto wake na jamaa yake kufuata njia ya Bwana, kwa kuwa waadilifu na kutenda haki, ili Bwana atimize ahadi yake kwa Abrahamu.”

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Basi Bwana akasema, “Kilio dhidi ya Sodoma na Gomora ni kikubwa sana na dhambi yao inasikitisha sana,

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: kwamba nitashuka nione kama waliyoyatenda ni mabaya kiasi cha kilio kilichonifikia. Kama sivyo, nitajua.”

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Basi wale watu wakageuka wakaenda kuelekea Sodoma, lakini Abrahamu akabaki amesimama mbele za Bwana.

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Ndipo Abrahamu akamsogelea akasema: “Je, utawaangamiza wenye haki na waovu?

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Je, ikiwa watakuwepo watu wenye haki hamsini katika mji huo, hivi kweli utauangamiza na wala hutauacha kwa ajili ya hao watu hamsini wenye haki waliomo ndani yake?

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Hilo na liwe mbali nawe, kufanya jambo kama hilo, kuwaua wenye haki pamoja na waovu, kuwatendea wenye haki sawasawa na waovu. Iwe mbali nawe! Je, Mwamuzi wa dunia yote hatafanya lililo sawa?”

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Bwana akasema, “Kama nikipata watu hamsini wenye haki katika mji wa Sodoma, nitausamehe huo mji wote kwa ajili yao.”

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Kisha Abrahamu akasema tena: “Sasa kwa kuwa nimekuwa na ujasiri wa kuzungumza na Bwana, ingawa mimi si kitu bali ni mavumbi na majivu;

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content:
je, kama hesabu ya wenye haki imepungua watano katika hamsini, utauangamiza huo mji wote kwa ajili ya hao watano waliopungua?”
    Bwana akamwambia, “Kama nikiwakuta huko watu arobaini na watano, sitauangamiza.”

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content:
Abrahamu akazungumza naye kwa mara nyingine, “Je, kama huko watapatikana watu arobaini tu?”
    Akamjibu, “Kwa ajili ya hao arobaini, sitauangamiza.”

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content:
Ndipo akasema, “Bwana na asikasirike, lakini niruhusu nizungumze. Je, kama huko watakuwepo thelathini tu?”
    Akajibu, “Sitapaangamiza ikiwa nitawakuta huko watu thelathini.”

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content:
Abrahamu akasema, “Sasa kwa kuwa nimekuwa na ujasiri sana kuzungumza na Bwana, je, kama wakipatikana huko watu ishirini tu?”
    Bwana akajibu, “Kwa ajili ya hao ishirini, sitauangamiza.”

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content:
Abrahamu akasema, “Bwana na asikasirike, lakini niruhusu nizungumze tena mara moja tu. Itakuwaje kama watapatikana huko watu kumi tu?”
    Bwana akajibu, “Kwa ajili ya hao kumi, sitauangamiza.”

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Bwana alipomaliza kuzungumza na Abrahamu, akaondoka, naye Abrahamu akarudi nyumbani kwake.

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Malaika wale wawili wakafika Sodoma wakati wa jioni, naye Loti alikuwa ameketi kwenye lango la mji. Wakati alipowaona, aliondoka kwenda kuwalaki na kuwasujudia hadi chini.

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content:
Akasema, “Bwana zangu, tafadhali karibuni kwenye nyumba ya mtumishi wenu. Mnaweza kunawa miguu na kulala hapa kisha asubuhi na mapema mwendelee na safari yenu.”
    Wakamjibu, “La hasha, tutalala hapa nje uwanjani.”

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Lakini akasisitiza kwa nguvu kwamba waingie pamoja naye nyumbani kwake. Akawaandalia chakula, mikate isiyotiwa chachu, nao wakala.

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Kabla hawajaenda kulala, watu wote kutoka kila sehemu ya mji wa Sodoma, vijana kwa wazee, waliizunguka nyumba.

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Wakamwita Loti wakisema, “Wako wapi wale watu ambao walikuja kwako jioni hii? Watoe nje kwetu ili tuweze kuwalawiti.”

teaching.description: ISHMAELI KUWA TAIFA KUBWA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 18:9-19:5

content: Loti akatoka nje kuonana nao, akaufunga mlango nyuma yake,

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: akasema, “La hasha, rafiki zangu. Msifanye jambo hili ovu.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Tazama, ninao binti wawili ambao kamwe hawajakutana kimwili na mwanaume. Acha niwatoe nje kwenu, nanyi mnaweza kuwafanyia lolote mnalotaka. Lakini msiwafanyie chochote watu hawa, kwa sababu wako kwenye ulinzi chini ya dari langu.”

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Wakamjibu, “Tuondokee mbali.” Wakaendelea kusema, “Huyu mtu alikuja hapa kama mgeni na sasa anataka kuwa mwamuzi wetu! Tutakutenda vibaya kuliko wao.” Waliendelea kumlazimisha Loti na kusonga mbele ili kuvunja mlango.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Lakini watu wale waliokuwa ndani wakanyoosha mkono wakamvuta Loti ndani ya nyumba na kufunga mlango.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Kisha wakawapiga kwa upofu wale watu waliokuwa mlangoni mwa ile nyumba, vijana kwa wazee, hivyo hawakuweza kuupata mlango.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Wale watu wawili wakamwambia Loti, “Una mtu mwingine yeyote hapa, wakwe zako, wana au binti, ama yeyote mwingine aliye wako katika mji huu? Waondoe hapa,

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: kwa sababu tunapaangamiza mahali hapa. Kilio kwa Bwana dhidi ya watu wa hapa ni kikubwa kiasi kwamba ametutuma kupaangamiza.”

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Kwa hiyo Loti alitoka ili kuzungumza na wakwe zake, waliokuwa wamewaposa binti zake. Akawaambia, “Fanyeni haraka kuondoka mahali hapa, kwa kuwa Bwana yu karibu kuangamiza mji huu!” Lakini wakwe zake walifikiri kwamba alikuwa akitania.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Kunako mapambazuko, malaika wakamhimiza Loti, wakamwambia, “Fanya haraka! Mchukue mke wako na binti zako wawili walioko hapa, la sivyo utaangamizwa wakati mji utakapoadhibiwa.”

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Alipositasita, wale watu wakamshika mkono wake na mikono ya mke wake na binti zake wawili na kuwaongoza salama nje ya mji, kwa kuwa Bwana alikuwa na huruma kwao.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Mara walipokwisha kuwatoa nje, mmoja wao akawaambia, “Mkimbie kwa usalama wenu! Msitazame nyuma, wala msisimame popote katika nchi tambarare! Kimbilieni milimani, ama sivyo mtaangamizwa!”

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Lakini Loti akawajibu, “La hasha, bwana zangu, tafadhalini!

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Mtumishi wenu amepata kibali mbele ya macho yenu, nanyi mmeonyesha wema mkubwa kwangu kwa kuokoa maisha yangu. Lakini siwezi kukimbilia milimani, janga hili litanikumba, nami nitakufa.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Tazama, hapa kuna mji karibu wa kukimbilia, nao ni mdogo. Niruhusuni nikimbilie humo, ni mdogo sana, ama sivyo? Ndipo maisha yangu yatasalimika.”

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Akamwambia, “Vema sana, nitalikubali hili ombi pia, sitauangamiza mji ulioutaja.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Lakini ukimbilie huko haraka, kwa sababu sitaweza kufanya lolote mpaka ufike huko.” (Ndiyo maana mji huo ukaitwa Soari.)

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Wakati Loti alipofika Soari, jua lilikuwa limechomoza katika nchi.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Ndipo Bwana akanyesha moto wa kiberiti uliotoka mbinguni kwa Bwana juu ya Sodoma na Gomora.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Hivyo akaiteketeza miji ile na eneo lote la tambarare, pamoja na wote waliokuwa wanaishi katika miji, hata pia mimea yote katika nchi.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Lakini mke wa Loti akatazama nyuma, hivyo akawa nguzo ya chumvi.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Asubuhi na mapema siku iliyofuata, Abrahamu akaamka na kurudi mahali pale aliposimama mbele za Bwana.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Akatazama upande wa Sodoma na Gomora, kuelekea nchi yote ya tambarare, akaona moshi mzito ukipanda kutoka kwenye nchi, kama moshi utokao kwenye tanuru.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Kwa hiyo Mungu alipoiangamiza miji ya tambarare alimkumbuka Abrahamu, akamtoa Loti kutoka kwenye lile janga lililoharibu miji ile ambamo Loti alikuwa ameishi.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Loti na binti zake wawili waliondoka Soari na kufanya makao yao kule milimani, kwa maana aliogopa kukaa Soari. Yeye na binti zake wawili waliishi katika pango.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Siku moja binti mkubwa akamwambia yule mdogo, “Baba yetu ni mzee na hakuna mwanaume mahali hapa atakayekutana na sisi kimwili, kama ilivyo desturi ya mahali pote duniani.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Tumnyweshe baba yetu mvinyo kisha tukutane naye kimwili ili tuhifadhi uzao wetu kupitia baba yetu.”

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Usiku ule walimnywesha baba yao mvinyo, alipolewa binti yake mkubwa akaingia na kukutana naye kimwili. Baba yao hakujua wakati binti yake alipoingia kulala naye wala alipotoka.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Siku iliyofuata binti mkubwa akamwambia yule mdogo, “Usiku uliopita mimi nilikutana kimwili na baba yangu. Tumnyweshe divai tena, usiku huu nawe ukutane naye kimwili ili tuweze kuhifadhi uzao wetu kupitia baba yetu.”

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Kwa hiyo wakamnywesha baba yao mvinyo tena usiku ule, naye binti yake mdogo akaingia, akakutana naye kimwili. Kwa mara nyingine baba yao hakujua binti yake alipolala naye wala alipoondoka.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA

teaching.description: SIKU YA SABATO, MUKHTASARI WA SIKU ZA UREJESHO, KUUMBWA KWA MWANADAMU, MASHARTI WALIOKABILIWA MWANADAMU NA MWANAMKE

  “Huyu sasa ni mfupa wa mifupa yangu

content: huko Abrahamu akasema kuhusu Sara mkewe, “Huyu ni dada yangu.” Kisha Abimeleki mfalme wa Gerari akatuma Sara aletwe, naye akamchukua.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Lakini Mungu akamjia Abimeleki katika ndoto wakati wa usiku na kumwambia, “Wewe ni kama mfu kwa sababu ya huyu mwanamke uliyemchukua; yeye ni mke wa mtu.”

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Wakati huo Abimeleki alikuwa bado hajamsogelea, kwa hiyo akasema, “Je, Bwana utaliharibu taifa lisilo na hatia?

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Hakusema kwangu, ‘Huyu ni dada yangu,’ naye Sara pia hakusema, ‘Huyu ni kaka yangu’? Nimefanya haya kwa dhamiri njema na mikono safi.”

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Kisha Mungu akamwambia katika ndoto, “Ndiyo, najua ya kwamba umefanya haya kwa dhamiri safi, kwa hiyo nimekuzuia usinitende dhambi. Ndiyo sababu sikukuacha umguse.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Sasa umrudishe huyo mke wa mtu, kwa maana ni nabii, naye atakuombea nawe utaishi. Lakini kama hutamrudisha, ujue kwa hakika kuwa wewe na watu wako wote mtakufa.”

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Kesho yake asubuhi na mapema Abimeleki akawaita maafisa wake wote, na baada ya kuwaambia yote yaliyotokea, waliogopa sana.

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Kisha Abimeleki akamwita Abrahamu na kumwambia, “Wewe umetufanyia nini? Nimekukosea nini hata ukaleta hatia kubwa namna hii juu yangu na ufalme wangu? Umenifanyia mambo ambayo hayakupasa kufanyika.”

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Wakati Bwana aliponifanya nisafiri mbali na nyumbani mwa baba yangu, nilimwambia, ‘Hivi ndivyo utakavyoonyesha pendo lako kwangu: Kila mahali tutakapokwenda, kuhusu mimi sema, “Huyu ni kaka yangu.” ’ ”

teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Kisha Abimeleki akatwaa kondoo na ngʼombe, na watumwa wa kiume na wa kike akampa Abrahamu, akamrudisha Sara kwa mumewe.

teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

content: Akamwambia Sara, “Ninampa kaka yako shekeli elfu moja za fedha. Hii ni kufidia kosa lililofanyika dhidi yako mbele ya wote walio pamoja nawe; haki yako imethibitishwa kabisa.”

teaching.description: UOVU WA KIMAADILI SODOMA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

teaching.name: Mwanzo 19:6-20:18

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Isaki alipokuwa na umri wa siku nane, Abrahamu akamtahiri, kama Mungu alivyomwamuru.

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Sara akasema, “Mungu ameniletea kicheko, kila mmoja atakayesikia jambo hili atacheka pamoja nami.”

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Akaongeza kusema, “Nani angemwambia Abrahamu kuwa Sara angenyonyesha watoto? Tena nimemzalia mwana katika uzee wake.”

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Mtoto akakua, akaachishwa kunyonya. Siku hiyo Isaki alipoachishwa kunyonya, Abrahamu alifanya sherehe kubwa.

teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Lakini Sara aliona kuwa mwana ambaye Hagari, Mmisri, aliyemzalia Abrahamu alikuwa anadhihaki,

teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Nitamfanya huyu mwana wa mtumishi wako wa kike kuwa taifa pia, kwa sababu naye ni uzao wako.”

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Maji yalipokwisha kwenye kiriba, akamwacha kijana chini ya mojawapo ya vichaka.

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Mungu akawa pamoja na huyu kijana alipokuwa akiendelea kukua. Aliishi jangwani na akawa mpiga upinde.

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Alipokuwa akiishi katika Jangwa la Parani, mama yake akampatia mke kutoka Misri.

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Wakati huo Abimeleki na Fikoli mkuu wa majeshi yake wakamwambia Abrahamu, “Mungu yu pamoja nawe katika kila kitu unachofanya.

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Sasa niapie hapa mbele za Mungu kwamba hutanitenda hila mimi, watoto wangu wala wazao wangu. Nitendee mimi na nchi ambayo unaishi kama mgeni wema ule ule ambao nimekutendea.”

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Abrahamu akasema, “Ninaapa hivyo.”

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Ndipo Abrahamu akalalamika kwa Abimeleki kuhusu kisima cha maji ambacho watumishi wa Abimeleki walikuwa wamekinyangʼanya.

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Lakini Abimeleki akasema, “Sijui ni nani ambaye amefanya hili. Hukuniambia, leo tu ndipo ninasikia habari zake.”

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Hivyo Abrahamu akaleta kondoo na ngʼombe, akampa Abimeleki, nao watu hawa wawili wakafanya mapatano.

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Abrahamu akatenga kondoo wa kike saba kutoka kwenye kundi,

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Abimeleki akamuuliza Abrahamu, “Ni nini maana ya hawa kondoo wa kike saba uliowatenga peke yao?”

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Abrahamu akamjibu, “Upokee hawa kondoo wa kike saba kutoka mkononi mwangu kama ushahidi kuwa nilichimba kisima hiki.”

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Hivyo mahali pale pakaitwa Beer-Sheba, kwa sababu watu wawili waliapiana hapo.

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Baada ya mapatano kufanyika huko Beer-Sheba, Abimeleki na Fikoli mkuu wa majeshi yake wakarudi katika nchi ya Wafilisti.

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

content: Abrahamu akapanda mti wa mkwaju huko Beer-Sheba, na hapo akaliitia jina la Bwana, Mungu wa milele.

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

teaching.description: KUZALIWA KWA ISAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 21

Baadaye Mungu akamjaribu Abrahamu. Akamwambia, “Abrahamu!”
    Abrahamu akajibu, “Mimi hapa.”

teaching.description: MUNGU AMWAMURU IBRAHIMU KUMTOA ISAKA KUWA DHABIHU
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:1-18

content: Kisha Mungu akamwambia, “Umchukue mwanao, mwana wako wa pekee, Isaki umpendaye, uende katika nchi ya Moria. Mtoe huko kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa juu ya mlima mmojawapo nitakaokuambia.”

teaching.description: MUNGU AMWAMURU IBRAHIMU KUMTOA ISAKA KUWA DHABIHU
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:1-18

content: Abrahamu akaamka asubuhi na mapema siku iliyofuata, akamtayarisha punda wake. Akawachukua watumishi wake wawili pamoja na Isaki mwanawe. Baada ya kuchanja kuni za kutosha kwa ajili ya hiyo sadaka ya kuteketezwa, akaondoka kuelekea mahali Mungu alipokuwa amemwambia.

teaching.description: MUNGU AMWAMURU IBRAHIMU KUMTOA ISAKA KUWA DHABIHU
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:1-18

content: Siku ya tatu Abrahamu akainua macho, akapaona mahali pale kwa mbali.

teaching.description: MUNGU AMWAMURU IBRAHIMU KUMTOA ISAKA KUWA DHABIHU
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:1-18

content: Akawaambia watumishi wake, “Kaeni hapa pamoja na punda, wakati mimi na kijana tunakwenda kule. Tutakwenda kuabudu na kisha tutawarudia.”

teaching.description: MUNGU AMWAMURU IBRAHIMU KUMTOA ISAKA KUWA DHABIHU
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:1-18

content: Abrahamu akachukua kuni kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, akamtwika Isaki mwanawe, yeye mwenyewe akachukua moto na kisu. Walipokuwa wakienda pamoja,

teaching.description: MUNGU AMWAMURU IBRAHIMU KUMTOA ISAKA KUWA DHABIHU
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:1-18

content:
Isaki akanena akamwambia Abrahamu baba yake, “Baba yangu!”
    Abrahamu akaitika, “Mimi hapa, mwanangu.”
    Isaki akasema, “Moto na kuni zipo, Je, yuko wapi mwana-kondoo kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa?”

teaching.description: MUNGU AMWAMURU IBRAHIMU KUMTOA ISAKA KUWA DHABIHU
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:1-18

content: Abrahamu akajibu, “Mwanangu, Mungu mwenyewe atajipatia mwana-kondoo kwa ajili ya hiyo sadaka ya kuteketezwa.” Nao hawa wawili wakaendelea mbele pamoja.

teaching.description: MUNGU AMWAMURU IBRAHIMU KUMTOA ISAKA KUWA DHABIHU
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:1-18

content: Walipofika mahali pale alipokuwa ameambiwa na Mungu, Abrahamu akajenga madhabahu hapo, akaziweka kuni juu yake. Akamfunga Isaki mwanawe na akamlaza kwenye madhabahu, juu ya zile kuni.

teaching.description: MUNGU AMWAMURU IBRAHIMU KUMTOA ISAKA KUWA DHABIHU
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:1-18

content: Kisha akanyoosha mkono wake na akachukua kisu ili amchinje mwanawe.

teaching.description: MUNGU AMWAMURU IBRAHIMU KUMTOA ISAKA KUWA DHABIHU
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:1-18

content:
Lakini malaika wa Bwana akamwita kutoka mbinguni, akamwambia, “Abrahamu! Abrahamu!”
    Akajibu, “Mimi hapa.”

teaching.description: MUNGU AMWAMURU IBRAHIMU KUMTOA ISAKA KUWA DHABIHU
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:1-18

content: Akamwambia, “Usimdhuru kijana, wala usimtendee jambo lolote. Sasa ninajua kwamba unamcha Mungu, kwa sababu hukunizuilia mwanao, mwana wako wa pekee.”

teaching.description: MUNGU AMWAMURU IBRAHIMU KUMTOA ISAKA KUWA DHABIHU
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:1-18

content: Abrahamu akainua macho yake, akaona kondoo dume amenaswa pembe zake nyuma yake katika kichaka. Akaenda akamchukua huyo kondoo dume, akamtoa awe sadaka ya kuteketezwa badala ya mwanawe.

teaching.description: MUNGU AMWAMURU IBRAHIMU KUMTOA ISAKA KUWA DHABIHU
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:1-18

content: Abrahamu akapaita mahali pale Yehova-Yire. Mpaka siku ya leo inasemekana, “Katika mlima wa Bwana itapatikana.”

teaching.description: MUNGU AMWAMURU IBRAHIMU KUMTOA ISAKA KUWA DHABIHU
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:1-18

content: Basi malaika wa Bwana akamwita Abrahamu kutoka mbinguni mara ya pili,

teaching.description: MUNGU AMWAMURU IBRAHIMU KUMTOA ISAKA KUWA DHABIHU
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:1-18

content: akasema, “Ninaapa kwa nafsi yangu, asema Bwana, kwamba kwa sababu umefanya jambo hili na hukunizuilia mwanao, mwana wako wa pekee,

teaching.description: MUNGU AMWAMURU IBRAHIMU KUMTOA ISAKA KUWA DHABIHU
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:1-18

content: hakika nitakubariki, na nitauzidisha uzao wako kama nyota za angani na kama mchanga ulioko pwani. Wazao wako watamiliki miji ya adui zao,

teaching.description: MUNGU AMWAMURU IBRAHIMU KUMTOA ISAKA KUWA DHABIHU
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:1-18

content: na kupitia uzao wako mataifa yote duniani yatabarikiwa, kwa sababu umenitii.”

teaching.description: MUNGU AMWAMURU IBRAHIMU KUMTOA ISAKA KUWA DHABIHU
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:1-18

content: Ndipo Abrahamu akawarudia watumishi wake, wakaondoka wakaenda wote pamoja mpaka Beer-Sheba. Abrahamu akaishi huko Beer-Sheba.

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: Baada ya muda, Abrahamu akaambiwa, “Milka pia amepata watoto, amemzalia ndugu yako Nahori wana:

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: Usi mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, Buzi nduguye, Kemueli (baba wa Aramu),

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: Kesedi, Hazo, Pildashi, Yidlafu na Bethueli.”

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: Bethueli akamzaa Rebeka. Milka alimzalia Nahori nduguye Abrahamu hao wana wanane.

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: Suria wake Nahori aliyeitwa Reuma pia alikuwa na wana: Teba, Gahamu, Tahashi na Maaka.

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: Sara aliishi akawa na umri wa miaka mia na ishirini na saba.

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: Sara akafa huko Kiriath-Arba (yaani Hebroni) katika nchi ya Kanaani, Abrahamu akamwombolezea na kumlilia Sara.

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: Ndipo Abrahamu akainuka kutoka pale penye maiti ya mke wake. Akazungumza na Wahiti, akasema,

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: “Mimi ni mpitaji na mgeni miongoni mwenu. Niuzieni sehemu ya ardhi yenu ili niweze kumzika maiti wangu.”

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: Wahiti wakamjibu Abrahamu,

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: “Bwana, tusikilize. Wewe ni mtawala mkuu sana miongoni mwetu. Zika maiti wako katika kaburi unalolipenda kati ya makaburi yetu. Hakuna mtu wa kwetu atakayekuzuia kaburi lake ili kuzika maiti wako.”

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: Abrahamu akainuka na akasujudu mbele ya wenyeji wa nchi, yaani Wahiti.

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: Akawaambia, “Kama mnaniruhusu kumzika maiti wangu, basi nisikilizeni mkamsihi Efroni mwana wa Sohari kwa niaba yangu

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: ili aniuzie pango la Makpela, lililo mali yake, nalo liko mwisho wa shamba lake. Mwambieni aniuzie kwa bei kamili atakayosema ili liwe mahali pangu pa kuzikia miongoni mwenu.”

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: Efroni Mhiti alikuwa ameketi miongoni mwa watu wake, akamjibu Abrahamu mbele ya Wahiti wote waliokuwepo katika lango la mji.

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: “La hasha, bwana wangu, nisikilize, nakupa shamba, pia nakupa pango lililomo ndani yake. Nakupa mbele ya watu wangu. Uzike maiti wako.”

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: Abrahamu akasujudu tena, mbele ya wenyeji wa nchi,

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: akamwambia Efroni wale watu wakiwa wanasikia, “Tafadhali nisikilize. Nitakulipa fedha za hilo shamba. Kubali kuzipokea ili niweze kumzika maiti wangu.”

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: Efroni akamjibu Abrahamu,

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: Hivyo shamba la Efroni huko Makpela karibu na Mamre, yaani shamba pamoja na pango lililokuwamo, nayo miti yote iliyokuwamo ndani ya mipaka ya shamba hilo, vilikabidhiwa,

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: kwa Abrahamu kuwa mali yake mbele ya Wahiti wote waliokuwa wamekuja kwenye lango la mji.

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: Baada ya hayo Abrahamu akamzika Sara mkewe kwenye pango ndani ya shamba la Makpela karibu na Mamre (huko Hebroni) katika nchi ya Kanaani.

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: Hivyo Wahiti wakamkabidhi Abrahamu shamba pamoja na pango lililokuwa humo kuwa mahali pa kuzikia.

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU ARUDI BIASHEBA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 22:18-23:20

content: Wakati huu Abrahamu alikuwa mzee mwenye miaka mingi, naye Bwana alikuwa amembariki katika kila njia.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Akamwambia mtumishi wake mkuu wa vitu vyote katika nyumba yake, yule aliyekuwa msimamizi wa vitu vyote alivyokuwa navyo, “Weka mkono wako chini ya paja langu,

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Ninataka uape kwa Bwana, Mungu wa mbingu na Mungu wa nchi, kwamba hutamtwalia mwanangu mke kutoka binti za Wakanaani, ambao ninaishi miongoni mwao,

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: bali utakwenda katika nchi yangu na jamaa zangu umpatie Isaki mwanangu mke.”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Yule mtumishi akamuuliza, “Je, kama huyo mwanamke atakataa kuja nami katika nchi hii? Je, nimpeleke mwanao katika hiyo nchi uliyotoka?”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Abrahamu akasema, “Hakikisha kwamba hutamrudisha mwanangu huko.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Bwana, Mungu wa mbingu, aliyenitoa nyumbani kwa baba yangu na nchi yangu niliyozaliwa na aliyesema nami na akaniahidi kwa kiapo, akisema, ‘Nitawapa watoto wako nchi hii,’ atatuma malaika wake akutangulie ili umpatie mwanangu mke kutoka huko.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Kama huyo mwanamke asipokubali kufuatana nawe, basi utafunguliwa kutoka kiapo nilichokuapisha. Ila usimrudishe mwanangu huko.”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Basi yule mtumishi akaweka mkono wake chini ya paja la bwana wake Abrahamu akamwapia kuhusu shauri hili.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Ndipo huyo mtumishi akachukua ngamia kumi miongoni mwa ngamia za bwana wake, akaondoka, akiwa amechukua aina zote za vitu vizuri kutoka kwa bwana wake. Akaelekea Aramu-Naharaimu na kushika njia kwenda mji wa Nahori.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Akawapigisha ngamia magoti karibu na kisima cha maji nje ya mji, ilikuwa inaelekea jioni, wakati ambapo wanawake wanakuja kuteka maji.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Kisha akaomba, “Ee Bwana, Mungu wa bwana wangu Abrahamu, nipatie ushindi leo, uonyeshe huruma kwa bwana wangu Abrahamu.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Tazama, nimesimama karibu na kisima hiki cha maji, nao binti za watu wa mji huu wanakuja kuteka maji.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Basi na iwe hivi, nitakapomwambia binti mmojawapo, ‘Tafadhali tua mtungi wako nipate kunywa maji,’ naye akisema, ‘Kunywa, nitawanywesha na ngamia wako pia.’ Basi na awe ndiye uliyemchagua kwa ajili ya mtumishi wako Isaki. Kwa hili nitajua umemhurumia bwana wangu.”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Ikawa kabla hajamaliza kuomba, Rebeka akatokea akiwa na mtungi begani mwake. Alikuwa binti wa Bethueli. Bethueli alikuwa mwana wa Milka aliyekuwa mke wa Nahori ndugu wa Abrahamu.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Huyu msichana alikuwa mzuri sana wa sura, bikira, ambaye hakuna mtu aliyekuwa amekutana naye kimwili. Aliteremka kisimani, akajaza mtungi wake akapanda juu.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Ndipo yule mtumishi akaharakisha kukutana naye akamwambia, “Tafadhali nipe maji kidogo katika mtungi wako.”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Yule msichana akasema, “Kunywa, bwana wangu.” Akashusha kwa haraka mtungi mkononi mwake na akampa, akanywa.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Baada ya kumpa yule mtumishi yale maji, akamwambia, “Nitateka maji kwa ajili ya ngamia zako pia mpaka wote watosheke.”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Akafanya haraka kumimina maji kwenye birika ya kunyweshea wanyama, akakimbia kisimani kuteka maji mengine na akateka ya kuwatosha ngamia wake wote.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Pasipo kusema neno, yule mtumishi akamtazama kwa makini aone kama Bwana ameifanikisha safari yake, au la.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Ikawa ngamia walipokwisha kunywa wote, yule mtumishi akampa huyo msichana pete ya puani ya dhahabu yenye uzito wa beka moja na bangili mbili za dhahabu zenye uzito wa shekeli kumi.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Kisha akamuuliza, “Wewe ni binti wa nani? Tafadhali uniambie, je, kuna nafasi katika nyumba ya baba yako tutakapoweza kulala?”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Yule msichana akamjibu, “Mimi ni binti wa Bethueli, mwana wa Milka aliyemzalia Nahori.”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Akaendelea kusema, “Kwetu kuna majani mengi na malisho, tena kuna nafasi kwa ajili yenu kulala.”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Yule mtumishi akasujudu na kumwabudu Bwana,

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: akisema, “Atukuzwe Bwana, Mungu wa bwana wangu Abrahamu, ambaye hakuondoa wema na uaminifu wake kwa bwana wangu. Mimi nami, Bwana ameniongoza safarini akanifikisha nyumbani kwa jamaa za bwana wangu.”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Yule msichana akakimbia akawaeleza watu wa nyumbani mwa mama yake kuhusu mambo haya.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Rebeka alikuwa na kaka aliyeitwa Labani, huyo akaharakisha kukutana na yule mtumishi kule kisimani.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Mara alipoiona ile pete puani, na bangili mikononi mwa dada yake na kusikia yale maneno Rebeka aliyoambiwa na huyo mtumishi, alimwendea huyo mtumishi, akamkuta amesimama karibu na ngamia wake pale karibu na kisima.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Akamwambia, “Karibu nyumbani wewe uliyebarikiwa na Bwana, kwa nini unasimama huko nje? Mimi nimekuandalia nyumba na mahali kwa ajili ya ngamia.”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content: Hivyo yule mtumishi akaenda nyumbani, mizigo ikaondolewa juu ya ngamia. Majani na malisho yakaletwa kwa ajili ya ngamia na maji kwa ajili yake na watu wake ili kunawa miguu.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI WA IBRAHIMU KUMTAFUTIA ISAKA MKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:1-32

content:
Ndipo chakula kikaandaliwa kwa ajili yake, lakini akasema, “Sitakula mpaka niwe nimewaambia yale niliyo nayo ya kusema.”
    Labani akasema, “Basi tuambie.”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Hivyo akasema, “Mimi ni mtumishi wa Abrahamu.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Bwana amembariki sana bwana wangu, amekuwa tajiri. Amempa kondoo na ngʼombe, fedha na dhahabu, watumishi wa kiume na wa kike, ngamia na punda.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Sara mkewe bwana wangu amemzalia mwana katika uzee wake, naye amempa kila kitu alichokuwa nacho.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Naye bwana wangu ameniapisha na akasema, ‘Kamwe usimtwalie mwanangu mke katika binti za Wakanaani, ambao ninaishi katika nchi yao,

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: ila uende mpaka kwa jamaa ya baba yangu na ukoo wangu mwenyewe, ukamtwalie mwanangu mke huko.’

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: “Kisha nikamuuliza bwana wangu, ‘Je, kama huyo mwanamke hatakubali kurudi nami?’

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: “Akanijibu, ‘Bwana ambaye nimetembea mbele zake, atatuma malaika wake pamoja nawe, na kuifanikisha safari yako, ili uweze kupata mke kwa ajili ya mwanangu katika ukoo wangu na kutoka jamaa ya baba yangu.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Kisha, utakapokwenda kwenye ukoo wangu, utakuwa umefunguliwa kutoka kiapo changu hata kama wakikataa kukupa huyo binti, utakuwa umefunguliwa kutoka kiapo changu.’

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: “Nilipokuja kisimani leo nilisema, ‘Ee Bwana, Mungu wa bwana wangu Abrahamu, ikikupendeza, naomba uifanikishe safari niliyoijia.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Tazama, ninasimama kando ya kisima hiki, kama mwanamwali akija kuteka maji nami nikimwambia, tafadhali niruhusu ninywe maji kidogo kutoka kwenye mtungi wako,

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: naye kama akiniambia, “Kunywa, nami nitateka maji kwa ajili ya ngamia wako pia,” basi huyo awe ndiye mke ambaye Bwana amemchagulia mwana wa bwana wangu.’

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: “Kabla sijamaliza kuomba moyoni mwangu, Rebeka akatokea, amebeba mtungi begani mwake. Akashuka kisimani akateka maji, nami nikamwambia, ‘Tafadhali nipe maji ninywe.’

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: “Akafanya haraka kushusha mtungi wake begani na kusema, ‘Kunywa na nitawanywesha ngamia wako pia,’ basi nikanywa, akawanywesha na ngamia pia.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content:
“Nikamuuliza, ‘Wewe ni binti wa nani?’
    “Akasema, ‘Mimi ni binti wa Bethueli, mwana wa Nahori, Milka aliyemzalia.’
    “Ndipo nilipotia pete puani mwake na bangili mikononi mwake,

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: nikasujudu na nikamwabudu Bwana. Nikamtukuza Bwana, Mungu wa bwana wangu Abrahamu, aliyeniongoza katika njia sahihi ili nimtwalie mwana na bwana wangu mke katika jamaa zake.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Ikiwa mtaonyesha wema na uaminifu kwa bwana wangu, mniambie, la sivyo, mniambie, ili niweze kujua njia ya kugeukia.”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Labani na Bethueli wakajibu, “Jambo hili limetoka kwa Bwana, hatuwezi kukuambia jambo lolote baya au jema.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Rebeka yuko hapa, mchukue na uende, awe mke wa mwana wa bwana wako, sawasawa na Bwana alivyoongoza.”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Ikawa huyo mtumishi wa Abrahamu aliposikia waliyosema, alisujudu mpaka nchi mbele za Bwana.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Ndipo huyo mtumishi akatoa vitu vilivyotengenezwa kwa dhahabu na kwa fedha pamoja na mavazi, akampa Rebeka, pia akawapa zawadi za thamani kubwa nduguye na mamaye.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content:
Kisha yeye na wale watu waliokuwa pamoja naye wakala, wakanywa na kulala palepale.
    Walipoamka asubuhi, yule mtumishi, akasema, “Nipeni ruhusa nirudi kwa bwana wangu.”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Lakini ndugu yake Rebeka pamoja na mama yake wakajibu, “Acha binti akae kwetu siku kumi au zaidi, ndipo mwondoke.”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Lakini yule mtumishi akawaambia, “Msinicheleweshe, kwa kuwa Bwana amefanikisha safari yangu, nipeni ruhusa nirudi kwa bwana wangu.”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Ndipo wakasema, “Acha tumwite huyo binti tumuulize, tusikie atakavyosema.”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content:
Kwa hiyo wakamwita Rebeka na kumuuliza, “Je, utakwenda na mtu huyu?”
    Akasema, “Nitakwenda.”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Hivyo wakamwaga ndugu yao Rebeka aondoke, pamoja na mjakazi wake, mtumishi wa Abrahamu na watu wake.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content:
Wakambariki Rebeka, wakamwambia,
  “Ndugu yetu, uwe wewe kumi elfu,
    mara elfu nyingi,
  nao wazao wako wamiliki
    malango ya adui zao.”

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Rebeka na vijakazi wake wakajiandaa, wakapanda ngamia zao wakafuatana na yule mtu. Hivyo yule mtumishi akamchukua Rebeka akaondoka.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Basi Isaki alikuwa ametoka Beer-Lahai-Roi, kwa kuwa alikuwa anaishi nchi ya Negebu.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Isaki akatoka kwenda shambani kutafakari wakati wa jioni, alipoinua macho yake, akaona ngamia wanakuja.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Rebeka pia akainua macho akamwona Isaki. Akashuka kutoka kwenye ngamia wake

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content:
na akamuuliza yule mtumishi, “Ni nani mtu yule aliye kule shambani anayekuja kutulaki?”
    Yule mtumishi akajibu, “Huyu ndiye bwana wangu.” Hivyo Rebeka akachukua shela yake akajifunika.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Kisha yule mtumishi akamweleza Isaki mambo yote aliyoyatenda.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Ndipo Isaki akamwingiza Rebeka katika hema la Sara mama yake, Isaki akamchukua Rebeka, hivyo akawa mke wake. Isaki akampenda, akafarijika baada ya kifo cha mama yake.

teaching.description: MTUMISHI AELEZEA TUME LAKE
teaching.name: Mwanzo 24:33-67

content: Abrahamu alioa mke mwingine, ambaye jina lake aliitwa Ketura.

teaching.name: Mwanzo 25

content: Yakobo akamwambia, “Niapie kwanza.” Hivyo Esau akamwapia, akamuuzia Yakobo haki yake ya kuzaliwa.

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU AOA KETURA NA KUWAPATA WANA ZAIDI; IBRAHIMU AMTAMBUA ISAKA KAMA MWANA ALIYECHAGULIWA; IBRAHIMU AFARIKI; UZAO WA ISHMAELI; TAARIFA KUHUSU ISAKA, YAKOBO NA ESAU; ESAU AMWUZIA YAKOBO HAKI YA MZALIWA WA KWANZA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 25

content:
Ndipo Yakobo akampa Esau mkate na ule mchuzi wa dengu. Akala na kunywa, kisha akainuka akaenda zake.
    Kwa hiyo Esau alidharau haki yake ya mzaliwa wa kwanza.

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU AOA KETURA NA KUWAPATA WANA ZAIDI; IBRAHIMU AMTAMBUA ISAKA KAMA MWANA ALIYECHAGULIWA; IBRAHIMU AFARIKI; UZAO WA ISHMAELI; TAARIFA KUHUSU ISAKA, YAKOBO NA ESAU; ESAU AMWUZIA YAKOBO HAKI YA MZALIWA WA KWANZA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 25

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU AOA KETURA NA KUWAPATA WANA ZAIDI; IBRAHIMU AMTAMBUA ISAKA KAMA MWANA ALIYECHAGULIWA; IBRAHIMU AFARIKI; UZAO WA ISHMAELI; TAARIFA KUHUSU ISAKA, YAKOBO NA ESAU; ESAU AMWUZIA YAKOBO HAKI YA MZALIWA WA KWANZA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 25

teaching.description: IBRAHIMU AOA KETURA NA KUWAPATA WANA ZAIDI; IBRAHIMU AMTAMBUA ISAKA KAMA MWANA ALIYECHAGULIWA; IBRAHIMU AFARIKI; UZAO WA ISHMAELI; TAARIFA KUHUSU ISAKA, YAKOBO NA ESAU; ESAU AMWUZIA YAKOBO HAKI YA MZALIWA WA KWANZA;
teaching.name: Mwanzo 25

content: Basi njaa kubwa ikawa katika nchi hiyo, kuliko ile njaa iliyotangulia iliyotokea wakati wa Abrahamu. Isaki akamwendea Abimeleki mfalme wa Wafilisti huko Gerari.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Bwana akamtokea Isaki, akamwambia, “Usiende Misri, bali ukae katika nchi nitakayokuambia.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Kaa katika nchi hii kwa kitambo, mimi nitakuwa pamoja na wewe na nitakubariki. Kwa maana nitakupa wewe na uzao wako nchi hizi zote na nitatimiza kiapo nilichomwapia Abrahamu baba yako.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Nitafanya wazao wako kuwa wengi kama nyota za angani, nami nitawapa nchi hizi zote na kutokana na uzao wako mataifa yote yatabarikiwa,

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: kwa sababu Abrahamu alinitii mimi akatunza kanuni zangu na maagizo yangu, amri zangu pamoja na sheria zangu.”

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Hivyo Isaki akaishi huko Gerari.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Watu wa mahali pale walipomuuliza habari za mke wake, akasema, “Huyu ni dada yangu,” kwa sababu aliogopa kusema, “Huyu ni mke wangu.” Alifikiri, “Watu wa mahali pale wataweza kumuua kwa sababu ya Rebeka, kwa kuwa alikuwa mzuri wa sura.”

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Wakati Isaki alipokuwa amekaa huko siku nyingi, Abimeleki mfalme wa Wafilisti akachungulia dirishani, akaona jinsi Isaki alivyomkumbatia Rebeka mke wake.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content:
Abimeleki akamwita Isaki akamwambia, “Hakika huyu ni mke wako! Mbona uliniambia, ‘Huyu ni dada yangu?’ ”
    Isaki akamjibu, “Kwa sababu nilifikiri ningeweza kuuawa kwa sababu yake.”

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Ndipo Abimeleki akamjibu, “Ni nini hiki ulichotufanyia? Ingewezekana mtu yeyote akawa amekutana kimwili na mke wako, nawe ungeleta hatia juu yetu.”

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Hivyo Abimeleki akatoa amri kwa watu wote, akisema, “Yeyote atakayemnyanyasa mtu huyu au mkewe hakika atauawa.”

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Isaki akapanda mazao katika nchi hiyo, kwa mwaka huo huo, akavuna mara mia, kwa sababu Bwana alimbariki.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Isaki akawa tajiri, mali zake zikaendelea kuongezeka mpaka akawa tajiri sana.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Akawa na mifugo ya kondoo na ngʼombe, na watumishi wengi sana, kiasi kwamba Wafilisti wakamwonea wivu.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Kwa hiyo visima vyote vilivyochimbwa na watumishi wakati wa Abrahamu baba yake, Wafilisti wakavifukia, wakavijaza udongo.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Ndipo Abimeleki akamwambia Isaki, “Ondoka kwetu, kwa maana umetuzidi nguvu sana.”

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Basi Isaki akatoka huko akajenga kambi katika Bonde la Gerari, akaishi huko.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Ndipo Isaki akavichimbua tena vile visima vya maji ambavyo vilichimbwa siku zile za Abrahamu baba yake, ambavyo Wafilisti walivifukia baada ya kufa Abrahamu, akavipa majina yale yale ambayo baba yake alikuwa amevipa.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Watumishi wa Isaki wakachimba katika lile bonde wakagundua huko kisima chenye maji safi.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Lakini wachungaji wa Gerari wakagombana na wachungaji wa Isaki wakisema, “Maji haya ni yetu!” Ndipo akakiita kile kisima Eseki, kwa sababu waligombana naye.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Kisha wakachimba kisima kingine, lakini hata hicho pia wakakigombania, akakiita Sitna.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Akaondoka huko, akachimba kisima kingine, wala hakuna yeyote aliyekigombania. Akakiita Rehobothi, akisema, “Sasa Bwana ametufanyia nafasi, nasi tutastawi katika nchi.”

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Kutoka pale akaenda Beer-Sheba.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Usiku ule Bwana akamtokea, akamwambia, “Mimi ndimi Mungu wa Abrahamu baba yako. Usiogope, kwa maana mimi niko pamoja nawe, nitakubariki na kuongeza idadi ya wazao wako kwa ajili ya Abrahamu mtumishi wangu.”

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Isaki akajenga madhabahu huko, akaliitia jina la Bwana. Akapiga hema lake huko, nao watumishi wake wakachimba kisima.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Wakati huo, Abimeleki alikuwa amemjia kutoka Gerari, akifuatana na Ahuzathi mshauri wake, pamoja na Fikoli jemadari wa majeshi yake.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Isaki akawauliza, “Mbona mmekuja kwangu na ninyi mlinichukia na kunifukuza?”

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Wakamjibu, “Tuliona wazi kuwa Bwana alikuwa pamoja nawe, kwa hiyo tukasema, ‘Inabidi kuwe na kiapo cha mapatano kati yetu, kati yetu na wewe. Na tufanye mkataba pamoja nawe

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: kwamba hutatudhuru, kama jinsi nasi hatukuwanyanyasa bali tuliwatendea mema wakati wote na kuwaondoa kwetu kwa amani. Tena sasa umebarikiwa na Bwana.’ ”

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Basi Isaki akawaandalia karamu, nao wakala na kunywa.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Kesho yake asubuhi na mapema, wakaapizana wao kwa wao. Kisha Isaki akawaruhusu waende zao, wakamwacha Isaki kwa amani.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Siku hiyo watumishi wa Isaki wakaja wakampa habari kuhusu kisima walichokuwa wamekichimba, wakamwambia, “Tumepata maji!”

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Naye akakiita Shiba, mpaka leo mji huo unaitwa Beer-Sheba.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Esau alipokuwa na umri wa miaka arobaini, akamwoa Yudithi binti Beeri Mhiti, kisha akamwoa Basemathi binti Eloni Mhiti.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content: Hawa walikuwa chanzo cha huzuni ya Isaki na Rebeka.

teaching.description: PASTOR GEOFFREY WANJALA MUNIALO
teaching.name: Mwanzo 26

content:
Isaki alipokuwa mzee na macho yake yalipokuwa yamekosa nguvu asiweze kuona tena, akamwita Esau mwanawe mkubwa, akamwambia, “Mwanangu.”
    Akajibu, “Mimi hapa.”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Isaki akasema, “Mimi sasa ni mzee na sijui siku ya kifo changu.

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Sasa basi, chukua silaha zako, podo na upinde, uende nyikani, ukawinde nyama pori kwa ajili yangu.

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Uniandalie aina ya chakula kitamu nikipendacho uniletee nile, ili niweze kukubariki kabla sijafa.”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Basi Rebeka alikuwa akisikiliza Isaki alipokuwa akizungumza na mwanawe Esau. Esau alipoondoka kwenda nyikani kuwinda nyama pori na kuleta,

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Rebeka akamwambia Yakobo mwanawe, “Tazama, nimemsikia baba yako akimwambia ndugu yako Esau,

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: ‘Niletee mawindo, kisha ukaniandalie chakula kitamu nile, ili niweze kukubariki mbele za Bwana kabla sijafa.’

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Sasa, mwanangu, nisikilize kwa makini na ufanye yale ninayokuambia:

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Nenda sasa katika kundi ukaniletee wana-mbuzi wawili wazuri, ili niandalie chakula kitamu kwa ajili ya baba yako, kama vile anavyopenda.

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Kisha umpelekee baba yako ale, ili apate kukubariki kabla hajafa.”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Yakobo akamwambia Rebeka mama yake, “Lakini ndugu yangu Esau ana nywele mwilini, mimi nina ngozi nyororo.

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Itakuwaje kama baba yangu akinigusa? Itaonekana kwake kama niliyemfanyia ujanja na kuleta laana juu yangu badala ya baraka.”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Mama yake akamwambia, “Mwanangu, laana na iwe juu yangu. Fanya tu ninalokuambia, nenda ukaniletee hao wana-mbuzi.”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Kwa hiyo alikwenda akawaleta, akampa mama yake, akaandaa chakula kitamu, kama vile alivyopenda baba yake.

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Kisha Rebeka akachukua nguo nzuri za Esau mwanawe wa kwanza, alizokuwa nazo nyumbani, akamvika Yakobo mwanawe mdogo.

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Pia akamfunika mikononi na sehemu laini ya shingo kwa ngozi za mbuzi.

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Hatimaye akampa Yakobo hicho chakula kitamu pamoja na mkate aliouoka.

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content:
Akamwendea baba yake akasema, “Baba yangu.”
    Akajibu, “Naam, mwanangu, wewe ni nani?”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Yakobo akamwambia baba yake, “Mimi ni Esau mzaliwa wako wa kwanza. Nimefanya kama ulivyoniambia. Tafadhali uketi, ule sehemu ya mawindo yangu ili uweze kunibariki.”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content:
Isaki akamuuliza mwanawe. “Umepataje haraka namna hii, mwanangu?”
    Akajibu, “Bwana Mungu wako amenifanikisha.”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Kisha Isaki akamwambia Yakobo, “Mwanangu tafadhali sogea karibu nami ili nikupapase, nione kama hakika ndiwe Esau mwanangu, au la.”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Yakobo akasogea karibu na baba yake Isaki, ambaye alimpapasa na kusema, “Sauti ni ya Yakobo, bali mikono ni ya Esau.”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Hakumtambua, kwa sababu mikono yake ilikuwa na nywele kama ya ndugu yake Esau, kwa hiyo akambariki.

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content:
Akamuuliza, “Hivi kweli wewe ni mwanangu Esau?”
    Akajibu, “Mimi ndiye.”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content:
Kisha akasema, “Mwanangu, niletee sehemu ya mawindo yako nile, ili nipate kukubariki.”
    Yakobo akamletea naye akala, akamletea na divai akanywa.

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Kisha Isaki baba yake akamwambia, “Njoo hapa, mwanangu, unibusu.”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content:
Kwa hiyo akamwendea akambusu. Isaki aliposikia harufu ya nguo zake, akambariki, akasema,
  “Aha, harufu ya mwanangu
    ni kama harufu ya shamba
    ambalo Bwana amelibariki.

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content:
Mungu na akupe umande kutoka mbinguni
    na utajiri wa duniani:
    wingi wa nafaka na divai mpya.

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content:
Mataifa na yakutumikie
    na mataifa yakusujudie.
  Uwe bwana juu ya ndugu zako,
    na wana wa mama yako wakusujudie.
  Walaaniwe wale wakulaanio,
    nao wale wakubarikio wabarikiwe.”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Baada ya Isaki kumaliza kumbariki na baada tu ya Yakobo kuondoka kwa baba yake, ndugu yake Esau akaingia kutoka mawindoni.

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Naye pia akaandaa chakula kitamu akamletea baba yake. Kisha akamwambia, “Baba yangu, keti ule sehemu ya mawindo yangu, ili upate kunibariki.”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content:
Isaki baba yake akamuuliza, “Wewe ni nani?”
    Akajibu, “Mimi ni mwanao, mzaliwa wako wa kwanza, Esau.”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Isaki akatetemeka kwa nguvu sana, akasema, “Alikuwa nani basi, ambaye aliwinda mawindo akaniletea? Nilikula kabla tu hujaja na nikambariki, naye hakika atabarikiwa!”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Esau aliposikia maneno haya ya baba yake, akalia sauti kubwa na ya uchungu, na kumwambia baba yake, “Nibariki mimi, mimi pia, baba yangu!”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Lakini akasema, “Ndugu yako amekuja kwa udanganyifu na akachukua baraka yako.”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Esau akasema, “Si ndiyo sababu anaitwa Yakobo? Amenidanganya mara hizi mbili: Alichukua haki yangu ya kuzaliwa na sasa amechukua baraka yangu!” Kisha akauliza, “Hukubakiza hata baraka moja kwa ajili yangu?”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Isaki akamjibu Esau, “Nimemfanya yeye kuwa bwana juu yako, pia nimewafanya ndugu zako wote kuwa watumishi wake, nimemtegemeza kwa nafaka na divai mpya. Sasa nitaweza kukufanyia nini, mwanangu?”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Esau akamwambia baba yake, “Je, baba yangu una baraka moja tu? Unibariki mimi pia, baba yangu!” Kisha Esau akalia kwa sauti kubwa.

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content:
Baba yake Isaki akamjibu, akamwambia,
  “Makao yako yatakuwa
    mbali na utajiri wa dunia,
    mbali na umande wa mbinguni juu.

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content:
Utaishi kwa upanga,
    nawe utamtumikia ndugu yako,
  lakini wakati utakapokuwa umejikomboa,
    utatupa nira yake
    kutoka shingoni mwako.”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Esau akawa na kinyongo dhidi ya Yakobo kwa ajili ya baraka ambazo baba yake alikuwa amembariki. Akasema moyoni mwake, “Siku za kuomboleza kwa ajili ya baba yangu zimekaribia, ndipo nitamuua ndugu yangu Yakobo.”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Rebeka alipokwisha kuambiwa yale aliyoyasema Esau mwanawe mkubwa, alimwita Yakobo mwanawe mdogo, akamwambia, “Ndugu yako Esau anajifariji kwa wazo la kukuua.

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Sasa basi, mwanangu, fanya nisemalo: Kimbilia haraka kwa Labani ndugu yangu kule Harani.

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Ukae naye kwa muda mpaka ghadhabu ya ndugu yako itulie.

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Wakati ndugu yako atakapokuwa hana hasira nawe tena na amesahau uliyomtendea, nitakupelekea ujumbe urudi. Kwa nini niwapoteze wote wawili kwa siku moja?”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Kisha Rebeka akamwambia Isaki, “Nimechukia kuishi kwa sababu ya hawa wanawake wa Kihiti. Ikiwa Yakobo ataoa mke miongoni mwa wanawake wa nchi hii, wanawake wa Kihiti kama hawa, sitakuwa na faida kuendelea kuishi.”

teaching.description: ISAKA AMWAHIDI ESAU BARAKA
teaching.name: Mwanzo 27

content: Basi Isaki akamwita Yakobo, akambariki na akamwamuru, akisema, “Usioe mwanamke wa Kikanaani.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: Nenda mara moja mpaka Padan-Aramu, kwenye nyumba ya Bethueli baba wa mama yako. Uchukue mke kati ya binti za Labani ambaye ni ndugu wa mama yako.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: Mungu Mwenyezi na akubariki uwe na uzao uongezeke idadi yako upate kuwa jamii kubwa ya watu.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: Na akupe wewe na uzao wako baraka aliyopewa Abrahamu, upate kumiliki nchi unayoishi sasa kama mgeni, nchi ambayo Mungu alimpa Abrahamu.”

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: Kisha Isaki akamuaga Yakobo, naye akaenda Padan-Aramu, kwa Labani mwana wa Bethueli Mwaramu, ndugu wa Rebeka, aliyekuwa mama wa Yakobo na Esau.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: Sasa Esau akajua kuwa Isaki amembariki Yakobo na kumtuma kwenda Padan-Aramu ili achukue mke huko na kwamba alipombariki alimwamuru akisema, “Usioe mke katika binti za Wakanaani,”

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: tena kwamba Yakobo amewatii baba yake na mama yake naye amekwenda Padan-Aramu.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: Esau akatambua jinsi ambavyo baba yake Isaki anavyowachukia binti za Wakanaani.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: Ndipo Esau akaenda kwa Ishmaeli, akamwoa Mahalati, ndugu wa Nebayothi na binti wa Ishmaeli mwana wa Abrahamu, kuongezea wale wake wengine aliokuwa nao.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: Yakobo akatoka Beer-Sheba kwenda Harani.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: Alipofika mahali fulani, akalala hapo kwa sababu jua lilikuwa limetua. Akachukua jiwe moja la mahali pale, akaliweka chini ya kichwa chake akajinyoosha akalala usingizi.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: Akaota ndoto ambayo aliona ngazi imesimamishwa juu ya ardhi, ncha yake ikiwa imefika mbinguni na malaika wa Mungu wakawa wakipanda na kushuka juu yake.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: Juu yake alisimama Bwana, akasema, “Mimi ni Bwana, Mungu wa baba yako Abrahamu na Mungu wa Isaki. Nchi ambayo umelala juu yake, nitakupa wewe na uzao wako.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: Uzao wako utakuwa kama mavumbi ya nchi, nawe utaenea upande wa magharibi na mashariki, kaskazini na kusini. Kupitia wewe na uzao wako mataifa yote ya duniani yatabarikiwa.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: Niko pamoja nawe nami nitakulinda kila uendako na nitakurudisha katika nchi hii. Sitakuacha mpaka nitakapofanya hayo niliyokuahidi.”

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: Yakobo alipoamka kutoka usingizini, akawaza, “Hakika Bwana yuko mahali hapa, wala mimi sikujua.”

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: Kwa hiyo akaogopa, akasema, “Mahali hapa panatisha kama nini! Bila shaka hapa ndipo nyumba ya Mungu ilipo, hili ni lango la mbinguni.”

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: Asubuhi yake na mapema, Yakobo akalichukua lile jiwe aliloliweka chini ya kichwa chake, akalisimamisha kama nguzo na kumimina mafuta juu yake.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: Mahali pale akapaita Betheli, ingawa mji ule hapo kwanza uliitwa Luzu.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: Kisha Yakobo akaweka nadhiri, akisema, “Kama Mungu akiwa pamoja nami na kunilinda katika safari niendayo, akinipa chakula nile na nguo nivae

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: na nirudi salama nyumbani kwa baba yangu, hapo ndipo Bwana atakuwa Mungu wangu,

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: nalo jiwe hili nililolisimamisha kama nguzo litakuwa nyumba ya Mungu na katika yote utakayonipa nitakutolea wewe sehemu ya kumi.”

teaching.description: YAKOBO AONDOKA NYUMBANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 28

content: Kisha Yakobo akaendelea na safari yake na akafika kwenye nchi za mataifa ya mashariki.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Huko akaona kisima katika shamba, pamoja na makundi matatu ya kondoo yamelala karibu na kisima hicho kwa sababu walikuwa wanakunywa maji kutoka kwenye kisimani hicho. Jiwe lililokuwa mdomoni mwa kisima lilikuwa kubwa.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Wakati kondoo wanapokuwa wamekusanyika hapo, wachungaji huvingirisha jiwe hilo kutoka kwenye mdomo wa kisima na kunywesha kondoo. Kisha hulirudisha jiwe mahali pake juu ya mdomo wa kisima.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content:
Yakobo aliwauliza wachungaji, “Ndugu zangu, ninyi mmetoka wapi?”
    Wakamjibu, “Tumetoka Harani.”

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content:
Aliwaambia, “Je, mnamjua Labani, mjukuu wa Nahori?”
    Wakamjibu, “Ndiyo, tunamfahamu.”

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content:
Kisha Yakobo akawauliza, “Je, yeye ni mzima?”
    Wakasema, “Ndiyo, ni mzima, na hapa yuaja Raheli binti yake akiwa na kondoo.”

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Akasema, “Tazama, jua bado liko juu, si wakati wa kukusanya mifugo. Nywesheni kondoo na mwarudishe malishoni.”

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Walijibu, “Haiwezekani, mpaka kondoo wote wakusanyike na jiwe liwe limevingirishwa kutoka mdomo wa kisima. Ndipo tutanywesha kondoo.”

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Alipokuwa akizungumza nao, Raheli akaja pamoja na kondoo wa baba yake, kwa maana alikuwa mchunga kondoo.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Yakobo alipomwona Raheli binti Labani, ndugu wa mama yake, pamoja na kondoo wa Labani, alikwenda na kulivingirisha jiwe kutoka mdomoni mwa kisima na kuwanywesha kondoo wa mjomba wake.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Kisha Yakobo akambusu Raheli na akaanza kulia kwa sauti.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Yakobo alikuwa amemwambia Raheli kuwa yeye alikuwa jamaa ya baba yake, na kwamba ni mwana wa Rebeka. Basi Raheli alikimbia na kumweleza baba yake.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Mara Labani aliposikia habari kuhusu Yakobo, mwana wa ndugu yake, aliharakisha kwenda kumlaki. Akamkumbatia na kumbusu, halafu akamleta nyumbani kwake, kisha Yakobo akamwambia mambo yote.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content:
Ndipo Labani akamwambia, “Wewe ni nyama yangu na damu yangu mwenyewe.”
    Baada ya Yakobo kukaa kwa Labani mwezi mzima,

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Labani akamwambia, “Kwa vile wewe ni jamaa yangu, ndiyo sababu unifanyie kazi bila ujira? Niambie ujira wako utakuwa nini.”

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Labani alikuwa na binti wawili, binti mkubwa aliitwa Lea na binti mdogo aliitwa Raheli.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Lea alikuwa na macho dhaifu, lakini Raheli alikuwa na umbo la kupendeza na mzuri wa sura.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Yakobo akampenda Raheli, akamwambia Labani, “Nitakutumikia kwa miaka saba kwa ajili ya kumpata Raheli binti yako mdogo.”

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Labani akasema, “Ni bora zaidi nikupe Raheli kuliko kumpa mtu mwingine yeyote. Kaa pamoja na mimi hapa.”

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Kwa hiyo Yakobo akatumika miaka saba ili kumpata Raheli, lakini ilionekana kwake kama siku chache tu kwa sababu ya upendo wake kwa Raheli.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Ndipo Yakobo akamwambia Labani, “Nipe mke wangu. Muda wangu umekamilika, nami nataka nikutane naye kimwili.”

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Basi Labani akaalika watu wote wa mahali pale na akafanya karamu.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Lakini ilipofika jioni, akamchukua Lea binti yake akampa Yakobo, naye Yakobo akakutana naye kimwili.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Naye Labani akamtoa Zilpa, mtumishi wake wa kike, kuwa mtumishi wa Lea, binti yake.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Kesho yake asubuhi, Yakobo akagundua kuwa amepewa Lea! Basi Yakobo akamwambia Labani, “Ni jambo gani hili ulilonitendea? Nilikutumikia kwa ajili ya Raheli, sivyo? Kwa nini umenidanganya?”

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Labani akajibu, “Si desturi yetu kumwoza binti mdogo kabla ya kumwoza binti mkubwa.

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30

content: Maliza juma la arusi ya binti huyu, kisha pia nitakupa huyu binti mdogo, kwa kutumika miaka mingine saba.”

teaching.description: YAKOBO AFIKA HARANI
teaching.name: Mwanzo 29:1-30
